descripcion: EL NUMERO 40, sabado. La nina tiene fiebre; Sarah pide que recen por ella. Muere esa noche.
_guion: Texto del Guion jugable del Acto I.

knock.texto: Mrs Lewis. It is Mr Whitehead. I said I would come back.

abre.texto: She is burning with fever, Reverend. She will not wake properly.

doctor.texto: There is nothing anyone can do. Please pray for her, Reverend. Please pray for my baby.

reza.texto: I will pray for her tonight.
